result.rationale: IIG is an active fiber owner/operator, but Canada is not canonical. IIG and its parent are Delaware entities headquartered in California; BC/AB are secondary. Wafra is majority owner and Future Standard succeeded Post Road's digital-infrastructure platform.

identityResolution.foundersSellers: Jeffrey Yount is the disclosed co-founder and pre-close controller/transferor. New senior preferred units recapitalized IIG; Yount rolled from 30.5% to 15.2%-17.8% non-voting junior preferred. No other founder/seller was identified.

ownershipResolution.closingTerms: WRA II-Pioneer (S) 19.8%-21.4%; PRSOF II IIG 37.3%-40.4%; Yount 15.2%-17.8%; no other holder >=10%. Wafra obtained de facto control through three of seven board seats plus a fourth nomination right; Post Road had one and Yount two.

currentOwners.fund: Wafra Real Assets & Infrastructure II LP
currentOwners.stake: 19.8%-21.4% at close; >50% by 2026-06-08; current exact % undisclosed

currentOwners.fund: Post Road Special Opportunity Fund II LP
currentOwners.stake: 37.3%-40.4% at close under Post Road; current exact % undisclosed

ownershipResolution.currentFinding: IIG named Wafra as majority shareholder and Future Standard as its other backer on 2026-06-08. Wafra's increase mechanics and Yount's current stake are undisclosed.

operatingResolution.model: Owner/developer/operator, not services-only; offers dark fiber, waves, high-capacity internet and colocation.
operatingResolution.assetProof: IIG says it wholly owns Northern Tier and controls conduit, fiber and ILA sites; a federal permit records its construction and 50-year operation/maintenance ROW.

routes.name: Northern Tier
routes.detail: Wholly owned multi-conduit Pacific Northwest-Minneapolis system; 70% complete 2026-06-08; late-2026 target.

routes.name: Northern Rockies
routes.detail: Sandpoint, ID-Missoula, MT opened 2026-04-09, completing a sourced 1,000-mile Inland Northwest-Northern Wyoming corridor.

operatingResolution.geography: United States primary. The 2023 release cited WA, ID, MT, IL, NV, CA, BC and AB networks, but no dedicated Canadian route or mileage was sourced; treat BC/AB as secondary.

financings: Post Road interim financing, 2023-09; no ownership transfer disclosed.
ownershipChanges: Future Standard announced purchase of Post Road's digital-infrastructure platform on 2025-09-30; manager succession, not an announced IIG sale.
Wafra was majority by 2026-06-08; transaction details were not public.
